content: prefers-reduced-motion should reduce/replace non-essential large motion (parallax, sliding, zoom) rather than being used to strip all feedback; if disabling an animation would hide state-change information, a static alternative must replace it. Color-only status indicators (e.g., win highlight by color alone) fail for colorblind users and can disappear under forced-colors/high-contrast modes -- pair color with shape/icon/text.
